title: Deterministic Step Preserves Halting
statement: Let $K_0,B,P\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathcal O$ assign a Boolean oracle on finite bit strings to each of four indices, and let $x$ be a finite bit string. Let $l$ be a machine label with deterministic instruction $i$, let $st$ be a state whose 17 register values are all at most $B$, let $M\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1\}$ be a memory tape, and let $p\in\mathbb{Z}$ satisfy $0\le p\le P$. If executing $i$ from label $l$ with register vector determined by $st$, no prior answer, and memory configuration $(M,p)$ yields a configuration from which the machine eventually halts with answer $r\in\{0,1\}$, with the guard condition $G(x,B,P)$ holding at every time before halting, then the machine started at label $l$ with register vector determined by $st$, no prior answer, and memory configuration $(M,p)$ also eventually halts with answer $r$, with $G(x,B,P)$ holding at every time before halting.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal O$ is a family of four Boolean oracles on finite bit strings
$st$ is an exponential BFS machine state
$l$ is a machine label and $i$ is a deterministic instruction with $A(K_0)(l)=\mathrm{det}(i)$
Every one of the 17 register values encoded by $st$ is at most $B$
The run from the post-instruction configuration halts with answer $r$ and satisfies $G(x,B,P)$ at all earlier times
replaced:
Let $K_0,B,P\in\mathbb N$, let $\mathcal O$ be a family of four Boolean oracles on bit
strings, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $S$ be a register state with every
register at most $B$. Let $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a memory
tape, let $p\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $0\le p\le P$, and let $\ell$ be a machine label with
instruction $i$. If the machine’s instruction at $\ell$ is the deterministic instruction
$i$, and executing that instruction from label $\ell$ with register values given by $S$
and no prior answer yields a configuration from which the machine eventually halts with
answer $r$, while satisfying $G(x,B,P)$ at every time before halting, then it likewise
halts with answer $r$ from the configuration at label $\ell$ whose registers are given
by $S$, whose memory is $M$, and whose head is at $p$, with $G(x,B,P)$ holding at every
time before halting.
